scope: Parent-captured summaries of eight fresh image-only reviews. No human or finished-art acceptance.

reviews.findings: Scene reads as sleeping cat/window/book/lamp and quiet night. Tail crosses body like a bent limb; oval torso/small head separate. Abrupt ears, card-like pages, crowded lamp/muzzle and paper seam.
reviews.change: Curl the tail along the lower body, tucked near paws.

reviews.findings: Cat body/head assembled, U-tail ribbon ambiguous, foxlike ears, stiff book blocks. Moon/window/lamp legible and coherent colours.
reviews.change: Rebuild body-head-tail as a coherent pose.

checks.disposition: Observed head inset, rear-root pending tail replacement, shorter ears, removal of misleading light ellipse, cover and seated sill joint.

reviews.findings: Tail still a band tracing belly, oval body and round head assembled. Lamp light limited to rim. Window/moon/book/lamp legible, quiet focal area.
reviews.change: Clear rear attachment and some tail/belly separation.

reviews.findings: Cat readable as sleeping but featureless oval/cushion without paw or haunch. Book remains card-like. Balanced composition and clean edges.
reviews.change: Add a tucked forepaw beneath cheek with separation contour.

checks.disposition: Tail moved behind the haunch and bowed below belly; forepaw added after freeing one decorative node; shared coat material removes unexplained circular colour seam.

reviews.findings: Oval body dominates face; tail becomes hanging loop/hammock, ears seem separated. Window/moon/book/lamp clear, coherent subdued palette.
reviews.change: Tail should follow lower body more closely.

reviews.findings: Cat body suspended above pale wedge, tail like sling, tiny paw only contact. Head/closed eye readable; room objects recognizable. Sharp ear notch.
reviews.change: Compressed resting haunch with clear shelf contact, then tail curl.

checks.disposition: Verified actual arc coordinates before acting: front focus already y565.157 near the y563.4 sill; rear focus y555.322 was the unsupported region. Rear bottom contour pushed down .06 nominal extent while protected mounts stayed fixed; tail bow tightened with rear occlusion retained.

reviews.findings: Sleeping cat/book/lamp/night reads clearly. Underside still overlapping shapes; tail vs belly crescent ambiguous, resting weight weak, no cast light, large empty window; book lower edge partly detached.
reviews.change: Coherent curled silhouette, wrapped tail and broad contact.

reviews.findings: Room objects and resting cat clear. Oval body directly into face lacks neck/shoulder/tucked foreleg. Peach paw/muzzle ambiguous; tail partly extra belly contour. Book division and closed eye survive small size.
reviews.change: Distinct shoulder-to-paw contour and meaningful support overlap.

checks.disposition: Art gate remains open. Scalar proportions, local contour and registration fixes did not establish anatomical structure. Do not productize this as a finished cat preset or repeat an uninformative cosmetic loop; next use explicit body/haunch/foreleg/support construction.
